assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: Eluting peptides were analyzed in the mass spectrometer using data depend acquisition (DDA) mode.
quantification: For quantification, iBAQ values were generated via maxquant.
enrichment: experimentTypes: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

Azide-labelled malformin C or DMSO was incubated with protein lysate from patient derived glioblastoma stem-like cells (NCH421k), and a pulldown of the compound with Dibenzocyclooctyne (DBCO) agarose was performed in order to identify interacting proteins.

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemoproteomics target identification study using a clickable azide-labeled probe (Az-mal. C) and DBCO-agarose beads for affinity purification (AP-MS). Quantification was performed using iBAQ in a label-free DDA workflow.

scope: For the pulldown assay, 2 mg protein lysate from NCH421k cells was incubated with 25 μm Az-mal C or DMSO for 4 h at 4 °C.
About 20 μL Dibenzocyclooctyne (DBCO) agarose bead slurry (Jena Biosciences, Jena, Germany) was added to each sample and incubated under rotation for 16 h at 4 °C.
Proteins were eluted by incubation with 25 μL 2 × LDS loading dye with 2 × reducing agent (NU Page, Life Technologies) at 95 °C for 5 min.
a pulldown of the compound with Dibenzocyclooctyne (DBCO) agarose was performed in order to identify interacting proteins.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment used a chemical pulldown approach with azide-labeled malformin C and DBCO-agarose beads to isolate interacting proteins from cell lysate, which constitutes an affinity-purified complex scope.
